post_freeze_amendment: 2026-09-25: fixed an internal API-consistency inconsistency found via the held-out run (docs/v2/PHASE5_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md) - chembl_target_or_indication_result_to_evidence raised ValueError for a well-formed record with no real content to cite, unlike every other adapter's None-return skip convention. Changed to return None (signature updated to Optional[Evidence]); the two genuine caller-error cases (empty chembl_id, unrecognized operation) still raise ValueError, unchanged. This is behavior-preserving at the evidence/registry.py::normalize() boundary - the same records that were already correctly scored as skips in both validation and held-out runs remain skips; only the internal signaling mechanism changed, not any measured outcome (coverage, completeness, or gate results). Does not invalidate or require re-running the held-out set. One new regression test added (tests/test_evidence_adapters.py::test_chembl_molecule_result_with_no_real_content_returns_none). Full suite: 327 passed (was 326), 0 failed, 7 skipped.
